name: Citizenship by Marriage

qualifying_event.description: Marriage to a citizen of Saint Kitts and Nevis, followed by a minimum marriage duration, allows the foreign spouse to apply for registration as a citizen.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of ongoing marriage/cohabitation for the qualifying period.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a citizen of Saint Kitts and Nevis.

General minimum of 3 years of marriage under the Citizenship Act, Cap. 1.05, though this may be shortened for couples cohabiting in-country; not automatic -- requires formal registration application, financial self-sufficiency, and good character.
requirements.fix_path: Remain validly married (and, ideally, cohabiting in the Federation) for the qualifying period.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be of good character and financially self-sufficient.

evidence_required.document: Registration fee (EC$1,050-$2,050 plus legal representation EC$2,000-$5,000)

sources.title: Osher Advisors -- St Kitts and Nevis Citizenship by Marriage: Citizenship Act Cap. 1.05, general 3-year marriage minimum (shortenable for in-country cohabitation), not automatic, requires formal registration, financial self-sufficiency, good character, 6-12 month processing, EC$1,050-$2,050 fees plus EC$2,000-$5,000 legal representation

Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- Types of Citizenship: confirms marriage to a citizen as one of five citizenship pathways, but does not state a specific duration on this page

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- the official mofa.gov.kn page confirms marriage as a pathway but gives no duration figure; the specific 3-year minimum and process detail come only from a tier-3 law firm blog, not corroborated by the primary Citizenship Act text itself (unlike Trinidad and Tobago's build, where the Act text was directly fetched and quoted). Re-verify against the Citizenship Act, Cap. 1.05 directly if a more authoritative figure is needed.
